1.name: Recuperative Treatise
1.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff5|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3681|r Magic Damage, restores |cffffff600|r Magicka and Stamina, and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff6495|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff2864|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff2943|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff10115|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Echoing Vigor
4.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff14958|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

5.name: Concealed Weapon
5.description:
Slash an enemy, dealing |cffffff8099|r Magic Damage. 

If you strike an enemy from their flank you set them Off Balance.

When you leave Sneak or invisibility while in combat, increase your damage done with this ability by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff15|r seconds.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

6.name: The Tide King's Gaze
6.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff3442|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff3578|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff1508|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff1621|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff5325|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Echoing Vigor
4.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff7866|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

5.name: The Tide King's Gaze
5.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff1896|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff5110|r Flame Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

You generate |cffffff10|r Ultimate for each enemy hit by the initial blast, up to 6 times.

Steal an enemy's life force, dealing |cffffff12775|r Magic Damage and healing you or |cffffff3|r other nearby allies for |cffffff35|r% of the damage inflicted every |cffffff2|r seconds for |cffffff10|r seconds.

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.

2.name: Twilight Matriarch Restore
2.description:
Call on Azura to send a twilight matriarch to fight at your side. The twilight matriarch's zap deals |cffffff2060|r Shock Damage and its kick deals |cffffff2060|r Shock Damage.

Once summoned, you can activate the twilight matriarch's special ability for |cffffff3718|r Magicka, causing it to heal |cffffff2|r friendly targets for |cffffff19913|r and itself for |cffffff9956|r.

The twilight matriarch remains until killed or unsummoned.

3.name: Equilibrium
3.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

4.name: Degeneration
4.description:
Bind an enemy with chaotic magic, dealing |cffffff28356|r Magic Damage over |cffffff22|r seconds.

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

5.name: Inner Light
5.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Shooting Star
6.description:
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing |cffffff25352|r Flame Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down, and stunning them for |cffffff2|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff6871|r Flame Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

You generate |cffffff10|r Ultimate for each enemy hit by the initial blast, up to 6 times.

1.description: Reduces the Health, Magicka, and Stamina costs of your non Core Combat abilities by |cffffff6|r%.

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

4.name: Degeneration

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

5.name: Inner Light
5.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Ice Comet
6.description:
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing |cffffff20382|r Frost Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down and stunning them for |cffffff2|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff6679|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies damaged by either portion have their Movement Speed reduced by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

While slotted on either bar, casting a non-Ultimate ability has a |cffffff33|r% chance of causing your next Crystal Fragments to be instant cast at half cost, dealing |cffffff18526|r Magic Damage.

4.name: Hardened Ward

Conjure globes of Daedric energy for protection, granting a damage shield for you and your pets that absorbs |cffffff13707|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds.

This ability scales off the higher of your Max Health or Magicka and the shield is capped at |cffffff72|r% of your Max Health.

5.name: Inner Light
5.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Swarming Scion
6.description:
Transform into a monstrous creature of the night, instantly healing to full Health.

While transformed, your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina are increased by |cffffff10000|r, you heal for |cffffff16|r% of all damage you deal, and you can see enemies through walls. 

Bats also swarm around you and shred enemies that come close, dealing |cffffff3514|r Magic Damage every |cffffff1|r second.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff6678|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2093|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1674|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4585|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

4.name: Summon Unstable Clannfear
4.description:
Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric clannfear to fight at your side. The clannfear's headbutt deals |cffffff1279|r Physical Damage, while its tail spike hits nearby enemies for |cffffff1352|r Physical Damage after |cffffff1|r second.  

Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability for |cffffff3802|r Magicka, healing you for |cffffff6459|r and the clannfear for |cffffff3229|r.

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

5.name: Inner Light
5.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Ice Comet
6.description:
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing |cffffff17369|r Frost Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down and stunning them for |cffffff2|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff5691|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies damaged by either portion have their Movement Speed reduced by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff5719|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2017|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1614|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4419|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff843|r Magicka and |cffffff230|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff32|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff813|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff7292|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff4804|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

2.name: Malevolent Promise
2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

3.name: Cycle Unending
3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.

4.name: Pound of Flesh
4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2130|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

5.name: Veil's Forfeit
5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second.

2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide
4.description:

If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

2.name: Devout Guardian
2.description:

3.name: Bright Harbinger
3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.

4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.name: Steadfast Candescence
5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration
1.description:

2.name: An Eye for Exploitation
2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

3.name: Above and Beyond
3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.

4.name: Cutthroat's Focus
4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.

5.name: Share the Spoils
5.description:

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.

2.name: Scalding Rune
2.description:
Inscribe a rune of cosmic fire on the earth, which takes |cffffff2|r seconds to arm and lasts for |cffffff22|r seconds.

When triggered, the rune blasts all enemies in the target area for |cffffff10588|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff12756|r Flame Damage over |cffffff24|r seconds.

3.name: Degeneration
3.description:
Bind an enemy with chaotic magic, dealing |cffffff20616|r Magic Damage over |cffffff22|r seconds.

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

4.name: Summon Unstable Clannfear
4.description:
Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric clannfear to fight at your side. The clannfear's headbutt deals |cffffff1552|r Physical Damage, while its tail spike hits nearby enemies for |cffffff1640|r Physical Damage after |cffffff1|r second.  

Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability for |cffffff3586|r Magicka, healing you for |cffffff6821|r and the clannfear for |cffffff3409|r.

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

5.name: Inner Light
5.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Ice Comet
6.description:
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing |cffffff21055|r Frost Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down and stunning them for |cffffff2|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff6900|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies damaged by either portion have their Movement Speed reduced by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

1.name: Inexorable Descent
1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

2.name: Booming Voice
2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.

3.name: Wildfire Embers
3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff6398|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

4.name: Resolute Defense
4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.

5.name: Lead from the Front
5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

1.name: Abyssal Emergence
1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fate Realigned
2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.

3.name: Unbound Potential
3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.

4.name: Erudite's Rigor
4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve
5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

1.name: Nothing Wasted
1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.

2.name: Malevolent Promise
2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

3.name: Cycle Unending
3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.

4.name: Pound of Flesh
4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2130|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

5.name: Veil's Forfeit
5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

1.name: Tundra's Maw
1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Wild Adaptation
2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.

3.name: Glacial Obstinance
3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.

4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide
4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.

5.name: Bountiful Harvest
5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

1.name: Bastion of Light
1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1704|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

2.name: Devout Guardian
2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4668|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

3.name: Bright Harbinger
3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.

4.name: Judgment's Brand
4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.

5.name: Steadfast Candescence
5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.

1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration
1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.

2.name: An Eye for Exploitation
2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

3.name: Above and Beyond
3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.

4.name: Cutthroat's Focus
4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.

5.name: Share the Spoils
5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

2.name: Booming Voice
2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.

3.name: Wildfire Embers
3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff6398|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

4.name: Resolute Defense
4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.

5.name: Lead from the Front
5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

1.name: Abyssal Emergence
1.description:

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fate Realigned
2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.

3.name: Unbound Potential
3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.

4.name: Erudite's Rigor
4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve
5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

1.name: Nothing Wasted
1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.

2.name: Malevolent Promise
2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

3.name: Cycle Unending
3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.

4.name: Pound of Flesh
4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2130|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

5.name: Veil's Forfeit
5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.name: Wild Adaptation
2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

3.name: Glacial Obstinance
3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.

4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide
4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.

5.name: Bountiful Harvest
5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

1.name: Bastion of Light

Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1704|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

2.name: Devout Guardian
2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4668|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

3.name: Bright Harbinger
3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.

4.name: Judgment's Brand
4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.

5.name: Steadfast Candescence
5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.

1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration
1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

3.name: Above and Beyond

An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

4.name: Cutthroat's Focus
4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

5.name: Share the Spoils

Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

2.name: Font of Power
2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

3.name: Static Reverberation
3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff829|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.

4.name: Calculated Defense

Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff7702|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.

5.name: Sphere of Influence
5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff5073|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff6678|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2093|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1674|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4585|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff1048|r Magicka and |cffffff234|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff39|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff813|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff7565|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff4984|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

1.description:
Steal an enemy's life force, dealing |cffffff11635|r Magic Damage and healing you for |cffffff35|r% of the damage inflicted every |cffffff2|r seconds for |cffffff10|r seconds.

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.

2.name: Scalding Rune
2.description:
Inscribe a rune of cosmic fire on the earth, which takes |cffffff2|r seconds to arm and lasts for |cffffff22|r seconds.

When triggered, the rune blasts all enemies in the target area for |cffffff10581|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff12756|r Flame Damage over |cffffff24|r seconds.

3.name: Degeneration
3.description:
Bind an enemy with chaotic magic, dealing |cffffff20604|r Magic Damage over |cffffff22|r seconds.

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

4.name: Summon Unstable Clannfear
4.description:
Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric clannfear to fight at your side. The clannfear's headbutt deals |cffffff1550|r Physical Damage, while its tail spike hits nearby enemies for |cffffff1637|r Physical Damage after |cffffff1|r second.  

Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability for |cffffff3499|r Magicka, healing you for |cffffff6459|r and the clannfear for |cffffff3229|r.

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

5.name: Inner Light
5.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Ice Comet
6.description:
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing |cffffff21039|r Frost Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down and stunning them for |cffffff2|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff6894|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies damaged by either portion have their Movement Speed reduced by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff1010|r Magicka and |cffffff230|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff38|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff813|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff7292|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff4804|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

2.name: Booming Voice

Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
