1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2093|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1674|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4585|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff1004|r Magicka and |cffffff215|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff38|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff905|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff7565|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.
50.name: Blade of Woe

51.description: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by |cffffff50|r%.
51.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice

52.description: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff12|r seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.
52.name: Padomaic Sprint

53.description: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.
53.name: Shadowy Supplier

54.description: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.
54.name: Shadow Rider

55.description: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.
55.name: Spectral Assassin

56.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.
56.name: Intimidating Presence

57.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.
57.name: Persuasive Will

58.description: Reduces the Magicka and Health cost of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.
58.name: Mage Adept

59.description: Increases the duration of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.
59.name: Everlasting Magic

60.description:
Increases your Max Magicka and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff2|r% for each Mages Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.
60.name: Magicka Controller

61.description: Casting a Mages Guild ability grants you Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff150|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds.
61.name: Might of the Guild

62.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.
62.name: See the Unseen

63.description: Reduces the cost of your Psijic Order abilities by |cffffff15|r%.
63.name: Clairvoyance

64.description:
When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for |cffffff10|r seconds. When you reach |cffffff5|r spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing |cffffff5459|r Magic Damage.

This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.
64.name: Spell Orb

65.description:
While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5750|r damage. 

This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend |cffffff10|r seconds not Bracing.
65.name: Concentrated Barrier

66.description: While you are casting or channeling a Psijic Order ability you reduce your damage taken by |cffffff30|r%.
66.name: Deliberation

67.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.
67.name: Finders Keepers

68.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.
68.name: Swiftly Forgotten

69.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.
69.name: Haggling

70.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.
70.name: Clemency

71.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.
71.name: Timely Escape

72.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.
72.name: Veil of Shadows

73.description:
Activating a synergy restores |cffffff4|r% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

Current Bonus: |cffffff837|r Health, |cffffff575|r Stamina, and |cffffff2678|r Magicka.
73.name: Undaunted Command

74.description:
Increases your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka by |cffffff2|r% per type of Armor (Heavy, Medium, Light) that you have equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.
74.name: Undaunted Mettle

75.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff5|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases your Alliance Points gained by |cffffff1|r%.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff6468|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2093|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1674|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4585|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff1004|r Magicka and |cffffff215|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff38|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff905|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff7565|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff4984|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.

2.name: Crystal Fragments
2.description:
Conjure dark crystals to bombard an enemy, dealing |cffffff12058|r Magic Damage. Your next non-Ultimate ability cast within |cffffff3|r seconds costs |cffffff10|r% less.

While slotted on either bar, casting a non-Ultimate ability has a |cffffff33|r% chance of causing your next Crystal Fragments to be instant cast at half cost, dealing |cffffff20016|r Magic Damage.

3.name: Hardened Ward
3.description:
Conjure globes of Daedric energy for protection, granting a damage shield for you and your pets that absorbs |cffffff14353|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds.

This ability scales off the higher of your Max Health or Magicka and the shield is capped at |cffffff72|r% of your Max Health.

4.name: Summon Unstable Clannfear
4.description:
Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric clannfear to fight at your side. The clannfear's headbutt deals |cffffff1746|r Physical Damage, while its tail spike hits nearby enemies for |cffffff1835|r Physical Damage after |cffffff1|r second.  

Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability for |cffffff3499|r Magicka, healing you for |cffffff6700|r and the clannfear for |cffffff3349|r.

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

5.name: Inner Light
5.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Swarming Scion
6.description:
Transform into a monstrous creature of the night, instantly healing to full Health.

While transformed, your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina are increased by |cffffff10000|r, you heal for |cffffff16|r% of all damage you deal, and you can see enemies through walls. 

Bats also swarm around you and shred enemies that come close, dealing |cffffff3798|r Magic Damage every |cffffff1|r second.

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.

Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2093|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

5.description:

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

1.name: Swallow Soul
1.description:
Steal an enemy's life force, dealing |cffffff13105|r Magic Damage and healing you for |cffffff35|r% of the damage inflicted every |cffffff2|r seconds for |cffffff10|r seconds.

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.

2.name: Crystal Fragments
2.description:
Conjure dark crystals to bombard an enemy, dealing |cffffff12058|r Magic Damage. Your next non-Ultimate ability cast within |cffffff3|r seconds costs |cffffff10|r% less.

While slotted on either bar, casting a non-Ultimate ability has a |cffffff33|r% chance of causing your next Crystal Fragments to be instant cast at half cost, dealing |cffffff20016|r Magic Damage.

3.name: Hardened Ward
3.description:
Conjure globes of Daedric energy for protection, granting a damage shield for you and your pets that absorbs |cffffff14353|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds.

This ability scales off the higher of your Max Health or Magicka and the shield is capped at |cffffff72|r% of your Max Health.

4.name: Summon Unstable Clannfear
4.description:
Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric clannfear to fight at your side. The clannfear's headbutt deals |cffffff1746|r Physical Damage, while its tail spike hits nearby enemies for |cffffff1835|r Physical Damage after |cffffff1|r second.  

Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability for |cffffff3499|r Magicka, healing you for |cffffff6700|r and the clannfear for |cffffff3349|r.

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

5.name: Inner Light
5.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Swarming Scion
6.description:
Transform into a monstrous creature of the night, instantly healing to full Health.

While transformed, your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina are increased by |cffffff10000|r, you heal for |cffffff16|r% of all damage you deal, and you can see enemies through walls. 

Bats also swarm around you and shred enemies that come close, dealing |cffffff3798|r Magic Damage every |cffffff1|r second.

1.name: Inexorable Descent
1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

2.name: Booming Voice
2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.

3.name: Wildfire Embers
3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff6468|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

4.name: Resolute Defense
4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.

5.name: Lead from the Front
5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

1.name: Abyssal Emergence
1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fate Realigned
2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.

3.name: Unbound Potential
3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.

4.name: Erudite's Rigor
4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve
5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

1.name: Nothing Wasted
1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.

2.name: Malevolent Promise
2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

3.name: Cycle Unending
3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.

4.name: Pound of Flesh
4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2093|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

5.name: Veil's Forfeit
5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

1.name: Tundra's Maw
1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Wild Adaptation
2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.

3.name: Glacial Obstinance
3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.

4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide
4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.

5.name: Bountiful Harvest
5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

1.name: Bastion of Light
1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1674|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

2.name: Devout Guardian
2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4585|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

3.name: Bright Harbinger
3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.

4.name: Judgment's Brand
4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.

5.name: Steadfast Candescence
5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.

1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration
1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.

2.name: An Eye for Exploitation
2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

3.name: Above and Beyond
3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.

4.name: Cutthroat's Focus
4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.

5.name: Share the Spoils
5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.

1.name: Conservation of Energy
1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff1004|r Magicka and |cffffff215|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.

2.name: Font of Power
2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff38|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.

3.name: Static Reverberation
3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff905|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.

4.name: Calculated Defense
4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff7565|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.

5.name: Sphere of Influence
5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff4984|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff3|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

Reduces the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.
23.name: Athletics

24.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Reduces damage taken from Martial attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the amount of damage blocked by |cffffff1|r%

Increases damage done with Bash by |cffffff30|r

Reduces your damage taken while immune to crowd control by |cffffff1|r%
24.name: Heavy Armor Bonuses

25.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Increases damage taken from Magical attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Reduces the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff3|r%

Increases the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff10|r%
25.name: Heavy Armor Penalties

26.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff343|r for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff343|r.
26.name: Resolve

27.description:
Increases your Health Recovery by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.

You restore |cffffff108|r Magicka and Stamina when you take damage for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds. 

Current bonus: |cffffff108|r.
27.name: Constitution

28.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.  

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.
28.name: Juggernaut

29.description:
Increases the Magicka or Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%
29.name: Revitalize

30.description:
Increases your healing received by |cffffff1|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff1|r%
30.name: Rapid Mending

31.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of soil or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Generates: |c19D3FF1 Intuition|r
Maximum Intuition: |cFFFFFF2|r.
31.name: Hand Brush

32.description:
Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. 

Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty.

Only works on |cFFFFFFthe lowest three layers|r of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot.

|cFFFFFFUsing Augur does not consume a turn.|r
32.name: Augur

33.description: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.
33.name: Keen Eye: Treasure Chests

34.description: Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff40|r%.
34.name: Improved Hiding

35.description: Increases your chances of successfully Pickpocketing by |cffffff50|r%
35.name: Light Fingers

36.description: Increases the number of fence interactions you can use each day by |cffffff180|r%.
36.name: Trafficker

37.description: Improves your chances of forcing locks by |cffffff70|r%.
37.name: Locksmith

38.description: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by |cffffff40|r%.
38.name: Kickback

39.description:
Adds the selected contiguous group of facets to your area of control.

Consumes 1 turn.
39.name: Scry

40.description: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Simple difficulty.
40.name: Antiquarian Insight

41.description: Allows you to revive once every |cffffff1|r hour without spending a Soul Gem.
41.name: Soul Summons

42.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff2471|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.
42.name: Soul Shatter

43.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.
43.name: Soul Lock

44.description:
Allows you to feed on an unsuspecting target, killing them and increasing your Vampire Stage. Higher Stages make you a stronger Vampire at the cost of your humanity. Stages decrease over long periods of time. 

Stage 1/2/3/4

Health Recovery: -10%/-30%/-60%/-100%
Flame Damage Taken: +5%/+8%/+13%/+20%
Regular Ability Costs: +3%/+5%/+8%/+12%
Vampire Ability Costs: -6%/-10%/-16%/-24%
44.name: Feed

45.description:
Ignore the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak.

Decreases the time it takes to enter Sneak by |cffffff50|r%.
45.name: Dark Stalker

46.description: When you leave Sneak, invisibility, or Mist Form your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff6|r seconds.
46.name: Strike from the Shadows

47.description:
Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff15|r% based on your missing Health.

Current bonus: |cffffff1|r%
47.name: Undeath

48.description:
Allows you to infect another player with Noxiphilic Sanguivoria once every |cffffffweek|r by returning to the Vampire ritual site. 

Players already infected with Lycanthropy cannot be infected with Noxiphilic Sanguivoria.
48.name: Blood Ritual

49.description:
Reduces the cost of Sprint by |cffffff50|r%.

If you continuously Sprint for |cffffff3|r seconds you automatically become invisible.
49.name: Unnatural Movement

50.description:
Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.
50.name: Blade of Woe

51.description: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by |cffffff50|r%.
51.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice

52.description: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff12|r seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.
52.name: Padomaic Sprint

53.description: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.
53.name: Shadowy Supplier

54.description: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.
54.name: Shadow Rider

55.description: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.
55.name: Spectral Assassin

56.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.
56.name: Intimidating Presence

57.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.
57.name: Persuasive Will

58.description: Reduces the Magicka and Health cost of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.
58.name: Mage Adept

59.description: Increases the duration of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.
59.name: Everlasting Magic

60.description:
Increases your Max Magicka and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff2|r% for each Mages Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.
60.name: Magicka Controller

61.description: Casting a Mages Guild ability grants you Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff150|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds.
61.name: Might of the Guild

62.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.
62.name: See the Unseen

63.description: Reduces the cost of your Psijic Order abilities by |cffffff15|r%.
63.name: Clairvoyance

64.description:
When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for |cffffff10|r seconds. When you reach |cffffff5|r spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing |cffffff5459|r Magic Damage.

This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.
64.name: Spell Orb

65.description:
While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5750|r damage. 

This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend |cffffff10|r seconds not Bracing.
65.name: Concentrated Barrier

66.description: While you are casting or channeling a Psijic Order ability you reduce your damage taken by |cffffff30|r%.
66.name: Deliberation

67.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.
67.name: Finders Keepers

68.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.
68.name: Swiftly Forgotten

69.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.
69.name: Haggling

70.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.
70.name: Clemency

71.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.
71.name: Timely Escape

72.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.
72.name: Veil of Shadows

73.description:
Activating a synergy restores |cffffff4|r% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

Current Bonus: |cffffff837|r Health, |cffffff575|r Stamina, and |cffffff2678|r Magicka.
73.name: Undaunted Command

74.description:
Increases your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka by |cffffff2|r% per type of Armor (Heavy, Medium, Light) that you have equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.
74.name: Undaunted Mettle

75.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff5|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.
75.name: Continuous Attack

76.description:
Increases your experience gain with the Light Armor skill line by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases your Alliance Points gained by |cffffff1|r%.
76.name: Opportunist

78.description:
Increases your Spell Resistance by |cffffff2310|r. This effect is doubled if you are afflicted with Burning, Chilled, or Concussed.  

Increases your Magicka Recovery by |cffffff130|r.
78.name: Spell Attunement

79.description: Reduces the Magicka cost of your abilities by |cffffff7|r%.
79.name: Magicka Mastery

29.bonus: |cffffff8|r% Critical Damage and Critical Healing done

1.name: Swallow Soul
1.description:
Steal an enemy's life force, dealing |cffffff13105|r Magic Damage and healing you for |cffffff35|r% of the damage inflicted every |cffffff2|r seconds for |cffffff10|r seconds.

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.

2.name: Crystal Fragments
2.description:
Conjure dark crystals to bombard an enemy, dealing |cffffff12058|r Magic Damage. Your next non-Ultimate ability cast within |cffffff3|r seconds costs |cffffff10|r% less.

While slotted on either bar, casting a non-Ultimate ability has a |cffffff33|r% chance of causing your next Crystal Fragments to be instant cast at half cost, dealing |cffffff20016|r Magic Damage.

3.name: Hardened Ward
3.description:
Conjure globes of Daedric energy for protection, granting a damage shield for you and your pets that absorbs |cffffff14353|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds.

This ability scales off the higher of your Max Health or Magicka and the shield is capped at |cffffff72|r% of your Max Health.

4.name: Summon Unstable Clannfear
4.description:
Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric clannfear to fight at your side. The clannfear's headbutt deals |cffffff1746|r Physical Damage, while its tail spike hits nearby enemies for |cffffff1835|r Physical Damage after |cffffff1|r second.  

Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability for |cffffff3499|r Magicka, healing you for |cffffff6700|r and the clannfear for |cffffff3349|r.

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

5.name: Inner Light
5.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Swarming Scion
6.description:
Transform into a monstrous creature of the night, instantly healing to full Health.

While transformed, your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina are increased by |cffffff10000|r, you heal for |cffffff16|r% of all damage you deal, and you can see enemies through walls. 

Bats also swarm around you and shred enemies that come close, dealing |cffffff3798|r Magic Damage every |cffffff1|r second.

1.name: Inexorable Descent
1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

2.name: Booming Voice
2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.

3.name: Wildfire Embers
3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff6468|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

4.name: Resolute Defense
4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.

5.name: Lead from the Front
5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

1.name: Abyssal Emergence
1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fate Realigned
2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.

3.name: Unbound Potential
3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.

4.name: Erudite's Rigor
4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve
5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

1.name: Nothing Wasted
1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.

2.name: Malevolent Promise
2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

3.name: Cycle Unending
3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.

4.name: Pound of Flesh
4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2093|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

5.name: Veil's Forfeit
5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

1.name: Tundra's Maw
1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Wild Adaptation
2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.

3.name: Glacial Obstinance
3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.

4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide
4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.

5.name: Bountiful Harvest
5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

1.name: Bastion of Light
1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1674|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

2.name: Devout Guardian
2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4585|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

3.name: Bright Harbinger
3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.

4.name: Judgment's Brand
4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.

5.name: Steadfast Candescence
5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.

1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration
1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.

2.name: An Eye for Exploitation
2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

3.name: Above and Beyond
3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.

4.name: Cutthroat's Focus
4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.

5.name: Share the Spoils
5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.

1.name: Conservation of Energy
1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff1004|r Magicka and |cffffff215|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.

2.name: Font of Power
2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff38|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.

3.name: Static Reverberation
3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff905|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.

4.name: Calculated Defense
4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff7565|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.

5.name: Sphere of Influence
5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff4984|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
